The company’s solution enables in silico studies such as virtual patient simulations, trial design scenario testing, and predictive safety and efficacy assessments to inform R&D workflows and regulatory submissions. Its platform integrates diverse computational models for different therapeutic areas, allowing users to run simulations, analyze outcomes, and generate regulatory-relevant digital evidence. InSilicoTrials collaborates with scientific partners and research organizations to expand its library of models and facilitate the adoption of simulation technology in drug development and clinical research. We offer Pharma and MedTech companies state-of-the-art simulation tools that can highly reduce the cost and time of drugs & medical products’ development. The in silico technology can increase the quality of life of millions of patients by allowing cheaper treatments, bringing innovative drugs to the market in a shorter time, together with personalized cures and new solutions for rare diseases.

The company specializes in a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform designed to automate compliance with standards such as CMMC, NIST 800-171, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA. Their multi-tenant, asset-centric GRC-as-a-Service solution helps organizations in the Defense Industrial Base (DIB) manage complex regulatory requirements efficiently. The core product features compliance automation, asset-centric modeling, readiness assessments, evidence management, and continuous monitoring. IntelliGRC targets managed service providers (MSPs) and defense contractors, enabling them to deliver scalable GRC services. The platform is built by cybersecurity professionals, ensuring it meets the practical needs of its users. With a focus on facilitating third-party assessments, IntelliGRC aims to make compliance accessible and manageable for its clients.
